column2: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 典型例句(第2轮)
Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为典型例句练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。
because answers why, strongest tone|since = since, based on a known fact|as = as, weakest tone|now that = since|when because is used, so is not used in the main clause
Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.
column3: 既然大家都到了,我们开始上课吧。

column2: As for everyone is here, let's begin the class.|Because of everyone is here, let's begin the class.|Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.|For that everyone is here, let's begin the class.
column4: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.

column2: He didn't go to school because he was ill.

column1: 「他因为生病没去上学。」的正确英文是?

column4: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:He didn't go to school because he was ill.

column2: As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
column3: 由于天晚了,我们最好打车。

column1: _____ it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
column4: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 As。句意:由于天晚了,我们最好打车。

column2: Now that the work is done, you can rest.
column3: 既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

column2: Because of the work is done, you can rest.|Now that the work is done, you can rest.|For now the work is done, you can rest.|Now what the work is done, you can rest.
column4: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:Now that the work is done, you can rest.

column2: I stayed because the meeting was long.
column3: 因为会议很长,我留下来了。
